about: Fine windows at EMODnet's native cell for measured sea-floor scenes (measured analogues, docs/plan-landforms-frames.md), and height windows of the Copernicus DEM GLO-90 for structural and alluvial-fan scenes outside the European frames (docs/plan-landforms-structure.md). Centre in degrees, size_km a square in the window's CRS (the frame's, or the local UTM zone for `dem`). Built by scripts/window.py (`run` for EMODnet, `dem --all` for the DEM).
